recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
recipes.instructions: Marinate chicken, cook rice, layer them and steam.
recipes.author: Chef Kumar
recipes.description: Rich and flavorful layered Indian rice dish served with marinated chicken and aromatic spices.

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.instructions: Cook tomato gravy and add sautéed paneer with cream.
recipes.author: Chef Priya
recipes.description: Succulent paneer cubes cooked in a rich, creamy, and mildly sweet tomato-based gravy.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
recipes.instructions: Bake dough with sauce and cheese at 220°C.
recipes.author: Chef Rossi
recipes.description: Simple yet classic Italian pizza topped with fresh tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, and sweet basil.

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
recipes.instructions: Spread batter, add potato filling, and fold.
recipes.author: Chef Guna
recipes.description: Crispy thin rice crêpe filled with a delicious, spiced potato mash and served with chutneys.

recipes.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
recipes.instructions: Slow cook mutton with spices until tender.
recipes.author: Chef Khan
recipes.description: Aromatic Kashmiri mutton dish slow-cooked with a rich gravy of yogurt and traditional spices.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pasta
recipes.instructions: Boil pasta and toss with sautéed vegetables.
recipes.author: Chef Smith
recipes.description: Healthy and vibrant pasta tossed with colorful sautéed seasonal vegetables and olive oil.

recipes.name: Fish Curry
recipes.instructions: Simmer fish in spicy tamarind and coconut gravy.aaa
recipes.author: Chef Nair
recipes.description: Coastal-style fish cooked in a tangy tamarind base and enriched with smooth coconut milk.

recipes.name: Gobi Manchurian
recipes.instructions: Fry cauliflower florets and toss in spicy sauce.
recipes.author: Chef Lee
recipes.description: Crispy deep-fried cauliflower florets tossed in a sweet, tangy, and hot Indo-Chinese sauce.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
recipes.instructions: Fry milk balls and soak in sugar syrup.
recipes.author: Chef Sharma
recipes.description: Soft and delicious berry-sized milk balls fried in ghee and soaked in sweet rose-scented cardamom syrup.

recipes.name: Classic Burger
recipes.instructions: Grill patty, layer with cheese and veggies in a bun.
recipes.author: Chef Burger
recipes.description: Juicy grilled patty layered with melted cheese, fresh lettuce, and savory sauces inside a toasted bun.
